content: When searching GitHub for Chinese e-commerce/sourcing/product selection related open source projects, prioritize topic-based searches (using qualifiers like topic:taobao, topic:1688, topic:aliexpress, topic:dropshipping, topic:电商) combined with in:name,description qualifiers for core keywords (e.g. 1688, 电商) instead of broad blind searches, to obtain more curated and relevant repository results.
